text: The Applicant for 100 Laurentide Drive has requested North York Community Council to exempt their property from the following by-law requirements: Chapter 447 Section 1.3 D(1) - Swimming Pool Enclosure; Enclosure height. The current fence in the rear yard on the main-floor deck has a height of 1.08 meters. This is less than the required 1.2 meters. City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 1.3 C(3) - Swimming Pool Enclosure; Access Protection In the rear yard, the basement sliding door has proposed construction of bolts disabling use of the door. This will eliminate access to the pool enclosure from this access point. Chapter 447 Section 1.3 E(1)(b) - Swimming Pool Enclosure; Construction standards In the rear yard, the man-door in the basement is not 1 meter away from a condition that facilitates climbing. The current Juliette style gate is 1.47 meters high. Municipal Licensing and…

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption for the property owner of 100 Laurentide Drive; directed and required that the enclosure be maintained in good repair without alteration; and at such time as replacement of the enclosure is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
